GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover 4 Lengths gone 600..vet-clear..rider-better suited to tracks with more give # very poor
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down near rear Hard Ridden 8l Beaten at the 400 Dropped Out , new stable # always under riding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Weakened from the 500m. Eased down from the 100m. Rider reported that the gelding, which was resuming from a spell, would be better suited racing over distances further than today’s 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 3 Wide 6 lengths. well back Wide turn. dropped out # Wide trip
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. under pressure turn. dropped out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider stated that passing the 900m when another runner which was positioned to his outside, showed intent to press forward to take up a position to the outside of the leader, he momentarily eased to assume the position behind the leader, however simultaneously, his mount came off the bridle, did not travel for the remainder of the race and proved disappointing. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality although it was noted that the gelding did have a relaxed heart rate.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked early to settle outside leader. 2nd turn. got to front in Straight . weakened late # worked early
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, joint lead Straightening Up , same 200m/100m, 2 horse battle to the line, headed 50m, kept on strong # led/kept finding
Jumped Well sat box seat 1 length off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off no room, off heels approaching 100m, hit line ok late # has excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1000m when racing keenly improved up onto the heels of rnr and had to be restrained. Was held up for clear running until passing the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind leader on inside (2L from lead). Tracked leader on inside midrace & held up Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along Two Wide @ 300m & pressured Two Wide @ 200m. Challenged leader @ 100m & shaded in last 50m. # Had his chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running in the early part of the home straight until passing the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6 lengths. well back turn. ran on well late # looking for longer
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1kg over in accordance with the policy. Passing the 900m was crowded by rnr which was taken in. Was held up over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide with cover 4 lengths. moved up 4 Wide turn 2 lengths. weakened. slow recovery # Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inconvenienced on straightening by rnr which had been taken out. When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of the gelding, rider advised that in his view his mount did not handle its big impost. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have a slow recovery rate.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside turn 3 lengths. ran on well with winner # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On straightening was contacted by a runner which forced a run to its inside.
